Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of a multi-lane roadway in Sugar Land, Texas, when the vehicle operated by
Driver 2 moved from the adjacent lane into the path of Driver 1's vehicle during a lane change. The two vehicles
sideswiped one another, and the resulting contact damage to the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle and the passenger
side of Driver 2's vehicle is consistent with the reported impact angle and direction of travel. Driver 1 reported a wrist
injury at the scene and was transported for evaluation. The injury described is consistent with the kind of force
expected from a collision of this type. Photographs taken at the scene confirm several of the reported details,
including vehicle positions and damage. No independent witnesses were identified. Responding officers and other
persons on scene confirmed that Passenger was present in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision. No prior
damage to Driver 1's vehicle is known to the reporting officer. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the applicable
policy. No citations were issued at the scene pending further review.
</page>
